<module id="signal_generator">
    <description>Generates a triangle wave signal by incrementing and decrementing a 5-bit signal named 'wave'.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <output id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">5-bit output waveform signal representing the generated waveform.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="INCREMENT" value="6'b000000"/>
        <parameter name="DECREMENT" value="6'b000001"/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="state" width="6">Controls the state of the waveform generation.</register>
        <register id="wave" width="5">Represents the generated waveform.</register>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= 6'b000000;
                wave <= 5'b00000;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    INCREMENT: begin
                        if (wave == 31) begin
                            state <= DECREMENT;
                        end else begin
                            wave <= wave + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    DECREMENT: begin
                        if (wave == 0) begin
                            state <= INCREMENT;
                        end else begin
                            wave <= wave - 1;
                        end
                    end
                    default: state <= INCREMENT;
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
